data.exact_reserve_text: During 2023, gross ultimate claims in respect of prior underwriting years (2021 and prior) decreased by $38.4m due to favourable experience in Syndicate 1919's Tech and Casualty divisions. On a net basis ultimate claims have increased by $0.6m, this is predominantly because the favourable gross experience in Casualty is net nil, due to the loss portfolio transfer on the 2020 & prior years of account. In addition, the Tech classes with favourable experience have been those with significant reinsurance.

prior_year_events.event_name: Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) with Starr Insurance and Reinsurance Limited
prior_year_events.impact_description: LPT ceded the 2020 and prior years of account on certain classes, operating on a funds withheld basis; this caused favourable gross Casualty experience to be net nil and affected net prior year movement.

data.standardized_narrative: During 2023 Syndicate 1919 reported a gross release on prior underwriting years (2021 and prior) of $38.4m driven by favourable claims experience in the Technical (Energy) and Casualty divisions. On a net basis, ultimate claims increased by $0.6m, largely reflecting the impact of a Loss Portfolio Transfer that ceded 2020 and prior years on certain classes and offset the gross favourable movement in Casualty. The movement is explicitly reported as a gross decrease and is therefore treated as a release.

data.data_quality_notes: All monetary figures are reported in the statements' native currency (USD). Opening gross claims outstanding sourced from the Statement of Financial Position (claims outstanding - gross amount, prior year column). Prior year development (gross) explicitly stated in the reserves note as a $38.4m decrease (release). Net movement (+$0.6m) is noted and attributed to the Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) ceding 2020 & prior years; where only net figures are discussed the gross figure was used when available. Claims development triangle is provided gross (units $000) and was not used to compute the prior year movement because an explicit gross prior-year movement sentence was available. Some LOB mappings (e.g. 'Tech' -> 'Energy') are interpretative based on report descriptions.
